defillama.status: Restricted redistribution; do not upload provider payloads to public Dune without permission
defillama.distinction: Official public API availability permits access; it is not a blanket data republication licence. No provider numerical results copied into this record.

publication.alternative: Compute metrics directly from public on-chain records in Dune; inspect public team query SQL and attribution/licence before reusing query text.

metricContract.grain: One completed logical order, deduplicated by protocol-specific canonical order key; source and destination legs joined rather than added.
metricContract.time: Completed UTC days; assign fees and notional to the SAME fill event/cohort; source-created cohorts are an alternative but must be explicitly consistent.

feeClasses.protocolService: Explicit protocol service charge, excluding solver/LP compensation, gas and optional integrator fees unless all peers include the same components.
feeClasses.executionCompensation: Solver/relayer/LP compensation; not necessarily protocol revenue or realized profit.
feeClasses.gas: Origin and destination execution costs, separately reported; avoid counting destination reimbursement twice.
feeClasses.allInUserCost: Only when actual input/output values, gas and app charges can be reconciled at matched asset prices; do not infer pure fees from cross-token price differences.

metricContract.aggregation: Ratio of sums, not mean of per-order fee rates. Publish priced/identified coverage and excluded notional; do not claim complete protocol volume.
metricContract.comparison: Within matching route/pair/size strata, then apply one fixed reference distribution for a standardized rate. Also show the unadjusted observed rate. No causal claim that solver count changes fee rate.
metricContract.missing: Missing fee is unknown, not zero; do not divide a complete numerator by a partial denominator or vice versa.
metricContract.solverDefinition: Distinct observed fill executor addresses completing orders in the period; not all registered or live solvers, nor independent firms. Publish labelled entity-adjusted count only with evidenced mappings.

api.migrationWarning: Current Across resources state legacy endpoints should not be used for new integrations and recommend /v1 endpoints; exact replacement analytics endpoint/schema not validated. Existing DefiLlama source still uses legacy endpoint. Do not assume anonymous access or perpetual API stability.

protocols.orderKey: Prefer canonical relayHash; otherwise validated originChainId+depositId with source contract/version namespace.
protocols.fees: Docs distinguish LP fees, relayer gas/capital/risk compensation and optional app fees. Relayer address of actual fill is observed executor; exclusiveRelayer is only nomination.
providerIssues: Fee adapter reads bridgeFeeUsd on filled deposits using fillBlockTimestamp, with deposit timestamp fallback.
Bridge adapter incoming volume is attributed to deposit time, not fill time.
Outgoing bridge volume excludes expired/refunded but can include still-unfilled deposits. Never sum incoming and outgoing into a one-sided completed-volume denominator.
Fee adapter currently sets LP fees to zero; cannot assume full LP+relayer economics are captured.
Fee adapter catches per-chain API failures and emits zero; missing chain coverage may look like low fees.

Fee pagination assumes older-data cutoff after page sequence even though indexer ordering is by deposit time; delayed fill dates can break fill-time early-stop logic. Bridge adapter separately notes skip pagination truncation and uses block range bisection.

contracts.provenance: Current DefiLlama bridge adapter; independently verify deployment address on each selected chain before SQL execution.

protocols.orderKey: orderId with source-contract/protocol namespace; do not count CreatedOrder and FulfilledOrder as separate completed swaps.
protocols.fees: Current fee adapter sums totalProtocolFeeUsd. Solver execution spread and costs are not measured by that field; affiliateFee is a distinct event field. Historical fixed/percent schedules must not substitute for observed realized fees.
protocols.volume: Current bridge adapter separately reports created-order outgoing giveAmount and filled incoming actualFulfillAmount (legacy takeAmount). Use fills joined to created orders, handle cancellations and patches explicitly, and price one matched side.
protocols.solver: FulfilledOrder sender is observed execution address, not necessarily independent solver entity. unlockAuthority is settlement authority and must not be used interchangeably.
